speaker: Patient
text: 18-month-old boy. The patient is brought in by his parents due to swelling in his right knee noticed after playing in the park. The parents report that there was no obvious injury or incident at the park that could have led to the swelling. Upon further questioning, the mother recalls that an uncle on her side of the family had similar problems, suggesting a possible genetic component.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Familial Juvenile Idiopathic Arthritis (likely HLA-B27 associated, given the male gender, knee involvement, and family history).

Given the lack of trauma and the strong familial pattern in a young male, this is highly suggestive of a genetic inflammatory condition rather than a mechanical injury. I will need to confirm this with inflammatory markers and imaging. REQUEST TEST: CBC, ESR, CRP. REQUEST IMAGES: Right_knee_Xray_ap_view.
